en.text:
That was—
That monster tsurugi!!

A lookalike? Not one chance in ten thousand. The unidentified tsurugi that had blocked me on the road to Kenchouji. Call that shape “distinctive” and the word would collapse from overwork.

A thousand years could pass. I would still remember.

Why here?
What for?

So it belonged to the occupation forces after all!?
And now, together with Ichizo Sorimachi—◆WHAT WERE THEY DOING!?

ja.html: あれは…… 　あの時の怪物騎!! 　万に一つも、別物の空似ということは有り得ない。 　あの日、建朝寺に向かう途上で、俺を阻んだ不明騎アンノウン ――特徴的などという一言では表しきれないその異形。 　千年経とうと、忘れる筈がなかった。 　何故、ここに。 　何の、ために。 　あれはやはり、進駐軍の戦力であったのか!? 　それが今、雪車町一蔵と結託して――◆何を!?

The bridge—

The bridge was destroyed!

So THAT was the arrangement!!
Our train was just about to enter it.
Now there was no bridge. Empty air, in the place of a bridge.

Below the air, a river.

—That was where this train was going to sink.

With me, with the Captain, with Sayo still inside.

en.html:
Only inertia was carrying the carriage now. But its speed was still terrible.
Add the weight of that enormous iron box.

All that momentum came at me.

Impossible————impossible!

Hold this thing?
Arre, I could barely stop it from running over me!

My arms and legs had become a prop. Let one part slip even slightly, and that instant my body would disappear under the wheels.
Even Muramasa’s steel could not keep me alive through that.

Against my feeble resistance the steel wheels rubbed the rails and shrieked.
To me, they were a meat-eater grinding its teeth over the meal in front of it.

How many times had I tasted the fear of death? Still not used to it. Still it threatened to drain the strength from my hands and feet.
I pulled every scrap of will together and held. I could not lose. Lose, and everything ended.

Me. The two inside. All of us.

Arms braced, legs braced. Face it. Push that monstrous mass back with muscle alone.

My feet kept sliding.
The soles burned like a tawa for grilling meat.

No grip.
No stopping the train. I could not stop it.

Where was the bridge—where the bridge had been?
How much space remained?

Before this train fell, how much—

ja.html:
惰性で走り続けているに過ぎない車両は、しかし、
まだ充分に高速だ。
　加えるに、鉄製の巨箱であるその重さ。

　途方もない<ruby>運動量<rt>モーメンタム</rt></ruby>が俺に襲い掛かる。

　無理だ――――無理だ！

　とてもこんなものは支えられない。
　<ruby>轢<rt>ひ</rt></ruby>き潰されぬようこらえるのが<ruby>漸々<rt>やっと</rt></ruby>。

　<ruby>つっかえぼう<rt>・・・・・・</rt></ruby>の形になっている四肢がわずかにでも
体勢を崩せば、その刹那、俺の肉体は車輪の下に消え
失せるだろう。
　村正の甲鉄も、一命を繋ぎ止める役には立つまい。

　微弱な抵抗を受けて<ruby>条鉄<rt>レール</rt></ruby>との間に摩擦を生じ、鋼の
車輪が耳障りな音をかき鳴らす。
　俺にはそれが、餌を目の前にした肉食獣の歯軋りと
しか聞こえなかった。

　幾度味わっても慣れることがない死の恐怖に、とも
すれば手足の力を失ってしまいそうになる。
　総身の意気を奮い起こして耐えた――負けてはなら
ない。負けたら終わりだ。

　俺も、中の二人も。

　立ち向かう。腕を張り脚を張り。あまりにも膨大な
質量を筋力のみで押し返す。

　だが両足は際限なく滑る。
　足裏は焼肉の鉄板さながらの高熱を発していた。

　踏み留まれない。
　列車は停まらない。停められない。

　橋は――橋があった場所は何処だ。
　あとどれだけの余裕がある。

　列車が落ちるまで、あとどれだけ、
